title: Sourdough Strawberry Muffins

components.name: Muffin Batter
ingredients: 15g (1 tbsp) olive oil or vegetable oil
200g (1 heaped cup) chopped strawberries, fresh or frozen
directions: Whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl. Set aside.
Add melted butter, oil, eggs, sugar, sourdough discard, vanilla, and buttermilk to a large mixing bowl. Whisk until well combined.
Add the flour mixture to the wet ingredients and fold with a rubber spatula until almost all combined.
Add strawberries and white chocolate chips and fold through.
Muffins can be baked right away or cold-fermented: cover the bowl and refrigerate up to 16 hours for a more moist crumb.

components.name: Streusel
directions: Add melted butter, flour, sugar, and salt to a small bowl. Use a fork to combine into a coarse crumb. Refrigerate 5 minutes if too soft.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease or line the muffin tin. Use an ice cream scoop to divide batter evenly — cups will be full.
Generously pile streusel on top of each muffin. Gently press it on.
Bake for 5 minutes at 425°F, then turn oven down to 350°F and bake for 18–20 more minutes, until golden brown and a cake tester comes out clean.
Let muffins cool in the pan for 5 minutes before removing to a wire rack.

notes: Buttermilk substitute: 170g regular milk + 10g white vinegar or lemon juice, mixed and left to curdle 5–10 minutes.
